entries.reason: The ledger and its ordered plan, operation and event records use typed Protobuf binary, JSON and envelope snapshots; operation payloads remain open-ended.
entries.schema: transaction:ledger version 2 stores fixed ledger fields in TransactionLedgerSave and dynamic operation payloads in a lossless recursive Protobuf value with distinct Int64 and Double variants.
entries.version: Binary and JSON writers emit version 2; legacy version 1 JSON remains readable through the existing restore API.
entries.migration: Legacy version 1 JSON and common Value envelopes are read into a detached ledger image; new writes use typed version 2 Protobuf binary, JSON and envelopes.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively; Protobuf JSON rejects unknown names, including nested operation payload messages.
entries.restore_atomicity: The full plan and event image is validated in temporary storage; the live ledger is replaced only after all records pass.

entries.reason: The transaction module exposes typed Protobuf ledger persistence and compatibility projections alongside the existing plan and script interfaces.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: Ledger snapshot and restore run on the owning transaction thread; restore does not invoke callbacks.
cost_notes: Binary save and restore cost linear time in plan, operation, event and payload bytes per snapshot.
